1
Zikr e Fatima Mir Sajjad Mir Lyrics
Zikar-e-Fatima Namaz Mein.
Hoga Barmala Namaz Mein.
Mang Lena Tum Bhi Kainat.
Jab Ho Fatima Namaz Mein.
Pichey Sajday Mein Hain Aasia.
Aagay Fatima Namaz Mein.
Fatima Gayin Nahi Kahin.
Aaye Mujtaba Namaz Mein.
Kash Fatima Se Bhi Koi.
Kuch Tu Mangta Namaz Mein.
Jashan-e-Fatima Hai Sheikh Jee.
Munh Tu Mat Bana Namaz Mein.
Gasibon Pe Be Shumar Kar.
Aaye Ga Maza Namaz Mein.
Sorah-e-Wal Adiyat Parh.
Manqabat Suna Namaz Mein.
Yaad Rakh Hussain Ki Namaz.
Sab Ko Bhool Ja Namaz Mein.
Sar Kata Hai Aayatein Nahi.
Dekh Mojza Namaz Mein.
Muskura Rahi Hain Fatima.
Parh Rahi Hain Kya Namaz Mein.
Mil Nahi Rahe They Murtaza.
Rabta Howa Namaz Mein.
 Mir Matami Miley Ga Bas.
Ya Azza Mein Ya Namaz Mein.

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = 'src/data/lyrics/zikr-e-fatima-mir-sajjad-mir-tajpoints-f9fb543bde367719da7d.md'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:'+p], text=True).split('\\n---\\n')[1].strip().splitlines()
meta, body = Path(p).read_text().split('\\n---\\n')
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines()
source = body.strip().splitlines()
assert roman[0] == '  1' and source[0] == '۱'
assert len(old[2:]) == len(roman[1:]) == len(source[1:]) == 26
assert [v.strip().rstrip('.').casefold() for v in old[2:]] == [v.strip().casefold() for v in roman[1:]]
assert '\\u200c' not in body
print('Verified 26 aligned verses and preserved Roman wording.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 26 verses in Urdu script and checked that they align with the Roman transcription in `romanLyrics`. Updated the title and right-to-left direction, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read “Gasibon” as غاصبوں and “Azza” as عزا.
